D019_m001.question:
It’s been a rough week, doctor. Ever since that… incident on the flight last Tuesday, I just haven't been myself. I keep replaying it over and over in my head, especially when I try to sleep. I'll be lying there, staring at the ceiling for hours, and then bits and pieces of it just flood back. The yelling, the panic… it's like I’m right back there in the aisle, even though I know I’m safe in my bed.

I even catch myself zoning out during conversations, like my mind just wanders somewhere else, away from what's happening around me. My friends have noticed I’m quiet, withdrawn. My head just feels… foggy. It's making it hard to focus at work too. I feel like I'm barely keeping it together. I used to love my job, seeing new places, meeting people, but now… it just feels like too much.
D019_m001.options:
A. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    B. Persistent Depressive Disorder
    C. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    D. Acute Stress Disorder

D019_m002.question: It's been about a week since that awful MVA with the two kids. I just can't shake it. Every night, I'm up by 3, sometimes 4 AM, eyes wide open, replaying it all. The screams, the blood... it just cycles through my head, over and over, no matter how hard I try to push it out. It's like a movie I'm forced to watch on repeat. During the day, things aren't much better. I'll be prepping meds or talking to a patient, and suddenly, I'm right back there in the ambulance bay. It's hard to focus, to even pretend I'm okay. I snapped at a tech yesterday, which isn't like me. I just feel so on edge, so… raw. It's making it really hard to do my job, and honestly, even just exist right now.
D019_m002.options:
A. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    B. Persistent Depressive Disorder
    C. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    D. Acute Stress Disorder

D019_m006.question:

It's weird though, I can remember the sound of the ambulance sirens perfectly, but I can't for the life of me recall what the driver looked like.

Sales have actually been decent, ironically, but I just… don't feel anything about it. Closed a big deal on a new truck yesterday, one my old boss would’ve bought me a steak dinner for, and I just felt… numb. No satisfaction, no pride, nothing. It's like my whole system's just running on empty, and it's starting to affect everything, even my focus at work. I just feel… off."
